The README states the scope limits and what the skill does not do. lean-kb states its limits in each README and in SKILL.md.

adopted: SKILL.md frontmatter with only name and description, and a self-contained skill folder. lean-kb uses the same frontmatter and keeps each file that the skill needs in one folder.
rejected: Distribution as a plugin marketplace entry. lean-kb is one skill with one hook, and a plugin manifest was not tested, so it ships as a plain folder.
